name: Money Momentum Savings Challenge
promise: Move the money first, then mark the progress.
description: A guided savings challenge system for envelope-style deposits, stash milestones, no-spend resets, and sustainable pace.

paths.name: $500 Starter Fund
paths.description: A 20-deposit challenge for building an early savings buffer.

sessionTemplates.title: Move the next stash deposit
sessionTemplates.lead: Intentions do not get colored in. Move the money first, then mark the envelope.
sessionTemplates.recommendedAction: Move a real deposit and confirm it happened.
sessionTemplates.companionFrame: Progress only counts after the money moves. That rule protects the challenge.

actions.label: Deposit moved
actions.helper: Enter the amount after it is actually moved.

actions.label: The money has actually moved
actions.helper: Only then does the envelope count.

paths.name: $1,000 Emergency Fund Sprint
paths.description: A focused emergency buffer path with sustainability checks.

sessionTemplates.title: Protect the emergency fund pace
sessionTemplates.lead: Make the next deposit real, then decide whether the current pace still fits normal life.
sessionTemplates.recommendedAction: Move a deposit and choose whether to keep or soften the pace.

actions.label: Emergency fund note
actions.placeholder: What helped or blocked this deposit?

paths.name: Custom Stash Builder
paths.description: Set your own deposit amount and repeatable savings rhythm.

sessionTemplates.title: Move a custom stash amount
sessionTemplates.lead: Choose the smallest honest deposit that keeps the challenge alive.
sessionTemplates.recommendedAction: Move a custom deposit and mark only what happened.

paths.name: No-Spend Challenge
paths.description: A reset path for reducing spending leakage and protecting the stash.

sessionTemplates.title: Protect the stash today
sessionTemplates.lead: A no-spend day is not about perfection. It is about making one leak visible and choosing a replacement.
sessionTemplates.recommendedAction: Name the leak and mark the protection action.

actions.label: Replacement move
actions.placeholder: Wait 24 hours, use pantry food, cancel one trial...

rhythmOptions.label: Daily
rhythmOptions.description: A small daily session that keeps money visible.

rhythmOptions.label: Weekly
rhythmOptions.description: A weekly session for a deeper review without daily pressure.

rhythmOptions.label: Sprint
rhythmOptions.description: A focused push for a short money goal or reset.

rhythmOptions.label: Custom
rhythmOptions.description: Use Draftpace when your schedule actually allows it.

intensityOptions.label: Gentle
intensityOptions.description: One minimum action. Best when you are rebuilding trust.
intensityOptions.companionModifier: Keep the action small enough to repeat.
intensityOptions.recoveryLine: Minimum progress still keeps the system alive.

intensityOptions.label: Steady
intensityOptions.description: A complete but calm session for normal weeks.
intensityOptions.recoveryLine: Return with one clean action and one note.

intensityOptions.label: Intense
intensityOptions.description: A stronger session when you have capacity.
intensityOptions.companionModifier: Use the extra capacity without turning it into pressure.
intensityOptions.recoveryLine: Compress back to the core action if the week shifts.

customizationOptions.label: Storage method
customizationOptions.description: Where the moved money will live.

recoveryBehavior.title: Minimum stash save
recoveryBehavior.trigger: Missed deposit, low momentum, or challenge pressure.
recoveryBehavior.minimumAction: Move the smallest honest amount and mark only that.
recoveryBehavior.companionLine: You are still in the challenge. A smaller deposit protects the rhythm.
